platform: Dirty Workz Native Hard Dance Demo Upload Route
manual_review_reason: The native form requires a final audio file, track title, email, artist name, genre and an originality/rights confirmation. Dirty Workz limits delivery to one track at a time and three per day, strongly discourages unofficial remixes or bootlegs, requires cleared samples and asks that the track remain exclusive for at least 30 days. A human must approve the master, rights, exclusivity window, metadata and cookie boundary before upload. Do not send demos to licensing@dirtyworkz.com or social channels.

platform: Scantraxx Hard Dance Tstack Demo Upload Route
manual_review_reason: Scantraxx accepts only finished Hard Dance productions in MP3 or WAV and rejects fully AI-generated tracks, works in progress and snippets. The official page embeds or links to an external Tstack uploader whose complete live fields, file limits, declarations, privacy terms and runtime challenge state require manual inspection. A human must confirm genre fit, final-master status, AI-use status, rights, metadata and the external form before upload.

platform: Dirtybird LabelWorx DemoBox Bass House Demo Route
manual_review_reason: The official LabelWorx DemoBox requires JavaScript, artist and track data, contact details, country, prior-label history, exclusivity status and an MP3 or WAV file. Submission includes rights, data-storage and gratis social/live-stream playback permissions. A human must review the unreleased/exclusive status, master, rights, optional marketing consent, privacy terms and permission language before any upload.

platform: Critical Music 320kbps reCAPTCHA Demo Submission Form
manual_review_reason: Critical Music welcomes demos through the Demo Submission option in its contact form, prefers 320 kbps audio and protects the form with reCAPTCHA. A human must inspect the live fields, prepare the correct audio/link package, confirm rights and label fit, and complete any human verification. The public press and label-management emails must not be used to bypass the authorized demo form.

platform: Shogun Audio LabelRadar Drum and Bass Demo Route
manual_review_reason: Shogun Audio's current Demos navigation points to LabelRadar, while its official contact page also publishes a Label Engine demo URL. A human must confirm the current destination, use an owner-controlled account/session, choose the correct label or imprint, review current credit or plan limits, supply rights-cleared metadata and approve the track before submission. General, shop and licensing emails are not substitute demo routes.
